tagline: Renewing Lives. Restoring Hope. Delivering Quality Care.
design_archetype: Organic & Earthy Healthcare Warmth meets Avant-Garde Editorial Precision (Awwwards-Level)

art_direction.concept: The Anti-Clinical Healing Sanctuary — bridging cutting-edge renal medicine with warm human compassion through Swiss typography, kinetic reveal animations, soft tactile textures, and generous asymmetric breathing room.
art_direction.theme_mode: Light Warm Silk base (#FAFAF7) with Midnight Tidal Teal contrast (#0B1E22) and vibrant Sage/Cerulean micro-accents.
signature_moments: Hero kinetic masked line-by-line reveal using Framer Motion
Numbered Editorial Manifesto chapters with progress tracking
Ultra-slow organic marquee tape displaying core values
Interactive 3D Vital Flow Canvas / Organic mesh wave sphere
High-density Bento Tetris grid for the 5 key renal services
Smooth momentum scrolling integration using Lenis

typography.heading_font: Cormorant Garamond, serif (or Outfit / Playfair Display)

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-semibold tracking-tight leading-[1.08]
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight leading-[1.15]
scale.overline: font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-teal-700 font-semibold

grid_layout_strategy.mode: Bento Tetris Grid Mode A & High Density Mode B

sections_breakdown.name: Navigation Bar
features: Brand identity with leaf/vitality symbol
Pill status badge: 'Angeles City Facility • Open Today 6:00 AM - 9:00 PM'
Desktop Nav items: Services, Why RenovaLife, Manifesto, Facility, Team, FAQ
Primary CTA button: 'Schedule a Visit / Consultation' with hover micro-glow
Emergency hotline badge: '(045) 888-RENAL / PhilHealth Direct Access'

sections_breakdown.name: Kinetic Hero Section
features: Masked line-by-line reveal animation for H1 ('Renewing Lives. Restoring Hope. Delivering World-Class Renal Care.')
Asymmetric split: Left editorial copy & key highlights, Right interactive 3D/Canvas Vitality Flow sphere
Floating trust markers: '100% PhilHealth Accredited', 'Zero-Infection Protocol Safety Standard', '24+ State-of-the-Art Dialysis Stations'
Dual action CTAs: 'Book Appointment' & 'Virtual Tour of Facility'

sections_breakdown.name: Slow Editorial Ribbon Marquee
features: Ultra-slow drifting text string with low-contrast warm sage background
Text phrase: 'COMPASSIONATE DIALYSIS CARE • ANGELES CITY • STATE-OF-THE-ART ULTRA-PURE WATER FILTRATION • PHILHEALTH ACCREDITED • INDIVIDUAL PRIVATE ENTERTAINMENT PODS • HUMAN-CENTERED HEALING'

sections_breakdown.name: Numbered Manifesto Chapters
features: Chapter 01: 'The Sanctuary of Life' - Moving away from scary hospital wards to human-first comfort.
Chapter 02: 'Uncompromised Purity' - German-engineered ultra-pure water purification systems guaranteeing zero endotoxins.
Chapter 03: 'Whole-Family Support' - Empowering dialysis patients and their families with nutrition, mental health, and financial guidance.

sections_breakdown.name: 5-Card Bento Services Grid
items: Hemodialysis Care (High-flux dialysis with personalized Kt/V targets)
Renal Care Support (Nephrology consultations, anemia & bone mineral management)
Patient & Family Support (Renal dietetics, psychosocial counseling, PhilHealth assistance)
Referral Coordination (Seamless hospital transfer & vascular access surgery routing)
Quality & Safety Assurance (Strict infection control, dual power redundancy, emergency backup)

sections_breakdown.name: Why RenovaLife (Differentiators)
features: Ergonomic automated reclining therapy chairs with built-in massage & heat support
Personalized Smart Entertainment displays (Netflix, Spotify, TV) at every station
Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi and quiet workspaces for working patients
On-site Board-Certified Nephrologist present during all treatment shifts
Specialized nutrition bar providing customized dialysis-friendly refreshments

sections_breakdown.name: About / Mission, Vision & Core Values
features: Interactive tabbed view: Mission • Vision • Core Values (Integrity, Empathy, Innovation, Safety)
Story of RenovaLife in Angeles City: Founded to provide world-class renal care without the financial or emotional stress.

sections_breakdown.name: Interactive Facility Showcase
features: High-definition spotlight image cards showing dialysis floor, water treatment unit, reception lounge, and private isolation room
Technical specs breakdown (Double-Pass Reverse Osmosis Water System, HEPA air purification)

sections_breakdown.name: Medical Leadership & Care Team
features: Dr. Maria Elena Santos, MD, FPCP, FPSN — Head Nephrologist
Dr. Gabriel Reyes, MD — Vascular Access & Renal Care Specialist
Nurse Supervisor Clarissa Pangilinan, RN, BSN — Senior Hemodialysis Nurse
Credentials, years of experience, and warm patient-first ethos quotes

sections_breakdown.name: Patient & Family Testimonials
features: Real patient transformation stories from Pampanga residents
Ratings, verified PhilHealth patient badges, and warm personal quotes

sections_breakdown.name: Patient Resources & FAQ Accordion
features: Searchable FAQ categories: PhilHealth Coverage, First-Time Dialysis, Vascular Access Care, Scheduling
Downloadable patient handbook & renal dietary guide callout card

sections_breakdown.name: Appointment & Consultation Form
features: Patient name, phone number, email, shift preference (Morning / Afternoon / Evening)
Treatment type selector (Regular Dialysis, First-Time Evaluation, PhilHealth Inquiry, Transfer Patient)
Interactive date picker using Shadcn calendar
Instant confirmation toast using Sonner and automated booking receipt preview

sections_breakdown.name: Editorial Footer & Map Information
features: Address: MacArthur Highway, Angeles City, Pampanga, Philippines
Direct Contact: +63 (045) 888-7362 / info@renovalifedialysis.ph
PhilHealth accreditation badge & DOH License information
Emergency hotline emphasis banner
Quick navigation links & copyright statement

motion_philosophy.smooth_scroll: Lenis smooth momentum scroll enabled on root window

animations.scroll_reveal: whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 30 }} transition={{ duration: 0.7, ease: [0.215, 0.61, 0.355, 1.0] }}

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, tabs, accordions, and cards must have kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-book-appointment-button', data-testid='service-card-hemodialysis', data-testid='faq-accordion-item-1').
testing_and_accessibility.apca_contrast: All text combinations strictly maintain minimum 4.5:1 contrast against backgrounds.
testing_and_accessibility.keyboard_focus: Explicit focus ring states on form controls and links.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a stunning single-page immersive website for RenovaLife Dialysis Center in React using Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling for luxury momentum feel.
Ensure all sections, images from guidelines, and interactive features (such as appointment booking, FAQ accordion, tabbed mission, service bento grid) are richly rendered with micro-animations.
Attach data-testid attributes to all interactive elements for test compliance.
Use sonner for instant toast notifications upon submitting the appointment form.
